pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form or a hotel asks for it

stop.words: a reaction happening now to an oil or a skin product: a swelling face, lips or throat, or trouble breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rinse the product off with cool water.

goOn.words: pregnant, a recent injury or surgery, a fever, a rash or a skin infection

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

pf.visit.checkIn: at the spa: the check-in code at the front desk, one code for a couples booking; at a home or hotel: the code at the door

pf.visit.beforeWork: each provider reads that guest's health form and asks about pressure before starting
pf.visit.inTurns: a package runs in order: the couples massage in the couples suite, 10 minutes in the quiet room, then a facial each in two facial rooms; a late start never pushes the next guest
pf.visit.changes: an add-on (hot stones, a scalp massage) is priced and OK'd before it's done
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the provider; notes for next time go in the guest's private record

pf.money.before: a card saved for single services; a 50% deposit for packages, couples and groups (the Couples Escape: $255), counted toward the total; a 25% deposit for a spa party at home, with the rest charged to the saved card at DONE
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting; many spas pick 48 hours for packages and groups)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $65 for a single service at the spa, $89 for a visit at home; for a package, the deposit may be kept; the owner confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed
pf.money.refunds: a full refund if the spa moves or cancels, or a room is out and no swap suits the guest
pf.money.tips: on: not included, optional, paid at the desk or on the bill; each tip goes in full to the provider who earned it
pf.money.giftCards: gift cards are sold on their own page and kept apart from bookings; taken off at the desk or on the secure page, never through the AI; expiry and fees only as the state's rules allow
pf.money.memberships: a monthly membership or a pack of visits, sold on the secure page with its own terms first
pf.money.tax: a tax line for products sold, where the state's rules require it

pf.messages.never: health answers (pregnancy, injuries, allergies, skin treatments) never go in a text or through the AI: only each guest's secure page and the providers serving that guest; a staff text says only that a note exists
pf.messages.guests: Rosie never texts a second guest who hasn't said yes; the booker forwards their link, and never sees that guest's answers
pf.messages.minors: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each person's massage or esthetics license per state, where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.skills: massage (Swedish, deep tissue, hot stones, prenatal) and facials and body treatments; only people with the skill and the license for a part are offered for it
pf.staff.supervision: students and apprentices work only under a licensed provider, where the state's rules allow
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs each group booking of 3 or more guests, a booking with a past product reaction, and a doctor's OK when the form asks for one; every price is on the menu, so no price needs an OK
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in needs the same skill and license, and gets the guest's form and notes; a swap is offered only when the guest didn't ask for someone by name; on a couples booking the other therapist is busy, so the stand-in is a third therapist (the example: Iris, who also covers the spa on Saturdays)
pf.staff.away: only people cleared for work away from the spa are offered for homes, hotels and offices

pf.rules.showLicense: each provider's license number shown in listings, the offer and the confirmation where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.hours: no massage in hours the state's or city's rules forbid (a switch from the state form), whatever the spa's own hours
pf.rules.away: massage and facials away from the spa only where the state's rules allow it
pf.rules.minors: a parent's written consent for a minor, and a parent present for massage, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.healthData: each adult gives their own health answers with their own yes (Rosie's rule everywhere); each state's own health-data rules from the state form
pf.rules.giftCards: gift card expiry and fees only as the state's rules allow
pf.rules.records: intake forms and visit notes kept with the guest's record: 7 years, or longer where the state asks
pf.rules.tips: tips paid in full to each provider, where the state's rules require it

pf.edges.lateArrival: services end on time so the next guest isn't pushed; the full price stands (agreed on the secure page); a rebook moves the deposit with no fee
pf.edges.noShow: marked 15 minutes after the start, with no word from the guest

pf.edges.formMissing: a guest's form not done before the visit: filled in on the desk's tablet at check-in
pf.edges.reaction: a reaction after a visit: aftercare tips, and Sam is told at once
pf.edges.party: a couples booking or a party: one booking, one check-in code, each guest's own form
